p: “And the children of Israel fabricated matters that were not right against the Lord their God” … There they did it in order to anger

“And the children of Israel fabricated matters that were not right against the Lord their God” (II Kings 17:9), which indicates that it is possible to make up stories about someone else even though they are entirely baseless. The Gemara answers: There they did it in order to anger
